verdict.rationale: Mastra ships a CLI (`npx mastra api workflow run ...`) that can trigger workflows non-interactively, and docs confirm it runs on standard Node.js/Bun/Deno/Cloudflare runtimes and can be deployed as a server or embedded in another app — all consistent with headless/CI use. However, there is no explicit CI/CD pipeline example, GitHub Actions template, or documented headless test-automation workflow in the evidence pack. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples, a documented non-interactive test/automation mode, and independent confirmation of headless operation in production.
